fato_historico: 1996: Hurricane Fran makes landfall near Cape Fear, North Carolina as a Category 3 storm with 115 mph sustained winds. Fran caused over $3 billion in damage and killed 27 people.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a shifting breeze, much like the wild winds that once swept the Carolina coast. Instead of resisting the gusts, consider how your inner four-leaf clover provides steady luck. It is a good time to ground yourself in your own calm center, turning potential emotional turbulence into a foundation for personal growth and lasting inner peace.
frase_do_dia: Stand firm like an ancient oak when the winds of change begin to blow.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of cycles and the wisdom gained from past experiences.
conselho: Trust your steady nature to navigate unexpected changes with grace and quiet strength.
